title.purpose: Card headings, column names, form section labels.

headline.purpose: Page headings, modal titles, section headers.

label.purpose: Metadata, timestamps, nav items, toolbar labels — the interface workhorse.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Job cards at rest — tight halo, barely perceptible, separates card from column background.

shadows.name: soft-hover
shadows.purpose: Job cards on hover — wider spread, lower opacity. Defined as shadow-soft in Tailwind config.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color and opacity state transitions (buttons, focus rings, hover backgrounds).

motion.name: ease-translate
motion.purpose: Position transitions — drawer slide, card reorder via dnd-kit transform. Ease-out expo feel.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Ocean Slate fill. Used for form submits, create actions, confirm dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #2D80D2; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2472BD; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2D80D2; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-prominence action. Transparent background. Used for toolbar icons, secondary actions in drawers.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>Open</button>

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with visible border. Used for 'Cancel', export actions, secondary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #161B24; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #DADDE8; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #ECEEF3; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2D80D2; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field. Used for job title, company name, URL fields throughout.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 36px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; background: #ffffff; color: #161B24; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #DADDE8; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #636C79; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2D80D2; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Badge — Secondary
components.description: Default tag chip. Used for pipeline stage labels, source tags.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; background: #ECEEF3; color: #161B24; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Job Card
components.description: Primary interface unit — the Kanban job card. Information-dense, compact, scannable. The 4px accent stripe on the left maps to column color.

Senior Engineer
Acme Corp
LinkedIn3d
components.css: .ds-job-card { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: stretch; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #DADDE8; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px -24px rgba(22, 27, 36, 0.6); overflow: hidden; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-job-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -24px rgba(22, 27, 36, 0.35); } .ds-job-card-stripe { position: absolute; inset-block: 0; left: 0; width: 4px; background: #2D80D2; border-radius: 8px 0 0 8px; } .ds-job-card-body { flex: 1; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; min-width: 0; } .ds-job-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #161B24; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-job-card-company { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #636C79; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-job-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 12px; } .ds-job-card-source { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #636C79; } .ds-job-card-time { font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; background: #ECEEF3; color: #636C79; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; background: rgba(247, 249, 251, 0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); border-bottom: 1px solid #DADDE8; } .ds-nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 176px; } .ds-nav-logomark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: #2D80D2; color: white; border-radius: 6px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #161B24; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #636C79; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #ECEEF3; color: #161B24; } .ds-nav-link--active { background: rgba(236, 238, 243, 0.7); color: #161B24; }

narrative.overview:
Applyline is a still room for a noisy process. Job searching generates dozens of decisions made under stress across fragmented platforms — the board is the one place where everything is visible, accountable, and quiet. The design answers this need with high information density and zero decoration: no gradients, no hero metrics, no celebration of the search itself.

The palette is disciplined — one Ocean Slate blue for action, a purple-violet structural accent used only in hardcoded column-badge contexts, and tinted blue-grey neutrals that recede entirely behind content. Typography is system-native (Avenir Next / Segoe UI Variable), inheriting from the OS without imposing itself. Motion is limited to state acknowledgment and drag reordering; the interface never moves unless the user initiated it.

This system explicitly rejects everything that makes generic SaaS dashboards feel like dashboards: no purple gradient backgrounds, no large-number hero cards, no sparkline widgets. Applyline should feel like a better tool than the places it's organizing.
keyCharacteristics: Single blue action color; accent (violet) appears only in Kanban column badge contexts
Flat-by-default surfaces; ambient shadow on cards at rest, soft shadow on hover
System font stack — no web font load, consistent across OS rendering engines
Light and dark themes equally considered from day one
Column accent colors are the only expressive color in the interface

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ocean Slate is the only color that speaks above the neutrals. It appears on ≤10% of any given screen. Its restraint is the point — when you see blue, there is something to do.

rules.name: The Column Exception
rules.body: Kanban column accent stripes use an expressive palette (amber, blue, green, teal, violet, red, slate, zinc). This is the only place in the interface where color is decorative rather than functional.

rules.name: The Size Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below 11px / 0.6875rem. Any label too long for 11px gets truncated rather than reduced further.

rules.name: The Weight Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Font weight does not exceed 600. Emphasis comes from weight contrast (400 vs 600), not from extremes.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If an element is not interactive-in-motion (hovered, dragged, or elevated as a modal), it has no shadow. Resting UI is flat.

rules.name: The Halo Rule
rules.body: The negative spread value (-24px) keeps shadows tight and directional — they hug the card rather than pooling beneath it. No diffuse glow shadows.

dos: Do use Ocean Slate (#2D80D2) exclusively for primary interactive elements — buttons, links, focus rings, the logo mark.
Do rely on weight contrast (400 vs 600) for typographic hierarchy.
Do keep card shadows tight and directional (-24px negative spread).
Do treat dark mode as a first-class surface.
Do use the column accent exception deliberately — for user-configured Kanban columns only.
donts: Don't use gradient backgrounds, gradient button fills, or background-clip gradient text.
Don't ship a purple-gradient hero or large-number metric card — this system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS dashboard template.
Don't copy the aesthetic of LinkedIn or Indeed: no corporate blue, no dense utilitarian tables.
Don't make Applyline feel like Trello — no bright multicolor card backgrounds, no playful rounded blobs.
Don't use font-bold (700) or heavier. The weight ceiling is 600.
Don't add a border-left stripe greater than 1px as a decorative accent on non-card elements.
Don't add shadows to dark-mode surfaces.
